# Sudoku Colouring Trainer

A Sudoku web app and solver focused on **Colouring techniques** rather than chain-based solving.

**[▶ Try it here](https://aiyuni.github.io/sudoku-colouring-trainer/)**

## Features

* Step-by-step, human-readable **Colouring technique applications**
* Puzzle generation specifically designed for **Colouring practice**
* Import puzzle strings generated by **[Sudoku.Coach](https://sudoku.coach/)** and **[SudokuWiki](https://www.sudokuwiki.org/)**
* Support for basic Sudoku techniques, and three Colouring techniques:

* **[Simple Colouring](https://www.sudokuwiki.org/Simple_Colouring)** - a widely documented single-digit Colouring technique.
* **[3D Medusa](https://www.sudokuwiki.org/3D_Medusa)** - a widely documented advanced multi-digit Colouring technique.
* **Dragon Colouring** - a novel, previously undocumented Colouring technique developed and implemented for this solver.  Dragon Colouring is designed to solve puzzles where even 3D Medusa cannot solve them.

In testing against the hardest puzzles from Sudoku.Coach, Dragon Colouring solves all **Hell** and **Beyond Hell** puzzles, whereas 3D Medusa get stuck at most **Hell** puzzles.

Claude code was used to implement this app.
